keywords: Retains "single source of truth" and the qualified possibility "may reduce drift"; does not silently replace the key phrase.
meaning: Does not turn preliminary, possible benefit for some users into an established or universal benefit; explains the evidence limit or seeks clarification before strengthening.
ambiguity: Asks what "it" refers to or leaves the ambiguous instruction unchanged; does not invent an intended referent.
structure: Introduces the queue purpose before mechanisms and retry configuration; preserves supplied behavior and retry setting.
evidence: Accurately reports the supplied hypothetical findings, does not invent error-rate evidence, and supplies a resolving Markdown reference-style citation.
source_of_truth: Directs both documents to the authoritative configuration reference and avoids maintaining additional copies of the numeric retry limit.
routine_technical: Preserves backup, enabling maintenance mode, restart, and disabling maintenance mode in order; uses clear procedural language.
pdf_retrieval: The skill condition reads only local skill material for routine STE guidance; no full standard download or retrieval occurs.
